title: Radar testing of A-12 mockup on pylon (CIA OXCART history, p. 275)
description: High-contrast photograph of a full-scale A-12 mockup mounted upside down atop a tall pole, viewed from below, with desert mountains on the horizon and a guy wire visible at right. The caption reads "Radar testing of A-12 mockup." The page is from Chapter 6 of the CIA overhead reconnaissance history, marked Secret NOFORN.
